name: HSE — getting a referral to children's disability services
description: HSE guidance on professional and parent/guardian referral to children's disability services, including needs-led routing to primary care or a Children's Disability Network Team.
intended_use: Use for child support/referral navigation without making support conditional on autism/ADHD diagnosis or Assessment of Need.
audience_or_context: Parents, guardians and professionals supporting children in the Republic of Ireland.
limitations: This route is to children's disability services, not automatically to an autism or ADHD diagnostic assessment.
Service destination depends on the child's needs and referral information.
Local waits and service arrangements can vary.
cost_or_access_notes: Parents or guardians can self-refer; the reviewed HSE page states a child does not need a diagnosis or Assessment of Need for referral.
conflicts_of_interest: HSE describes the public services it operates; ND Oracle records the needs-led referral route without assuming eligibility or outcome.

provenance.method: HSE children's disability referral page checked on 2026-09-04 for parent/professional referral, no-diagnosis requirement and needs-led routing. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
